name: seo-suite-dataforseo
description: Official DataForSEO MCP server (npm dataforseo-mcp-server 3.1.3, local stdio) for seo-suite. Pay-as-you-go calls; the seo-suite credit guard caches, clamps and budgets them.

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO API login
dataforseo_login.description: The API login from app.dataforseo.com/api-access (usually your account email). Stored in the system keychain.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password
dataforseo_password.description: The API password from app.dataforseo.com/api-access (not your dashboard password). Stored in the system keychain.
